entities.name: Ivra Jursdotter
entities.description: Mercenary captain who led her brigade across many battles in Sarpadia, serving the Ebon Hand and later the orcs.

entities.name: Ghazbán ogre
entities.description: Ogre that turned on Ivra's company in a disastrous encounter.

entities.name: Ebon Hand
entities.description: Order Ivra served as a mercenary for several years.

entities.name: Thurzen Klathe
entities.description: Member of the Order of the Ebon Hand who sent Ivra's company to aid Sarya Haasendel.

entities.name: Sarya Haasendel
entities.description: Dwarf trapped in an abandoned mine with the dwarven survivors.

entities.name: Orcs
entities.description: Orc-goblin army that attacked the dwarves and later employed Ivra.

entities.name: Fall of the Sarpadian Empires
entities.description: Event after which little is known of Ivra.

events.summary: Thurzen Klathe of the Ebon Hand sends Ivra's company to aid Sarya Haasendel, trapped in a mine with dwarf survivors.
events.quote: sent her company to aid Sarya Haasendel

events.summary: Ivra, dissatisfied with the Ebon Hand, joins the orcs and fights across Sarpadia.
events.quote: she joined up with the orcs instead

relations.note: She served as a mercenary for several years.
relations.quote: Ivra served the Ebon Hand as a mercenary for several years

relations.note: She later worked for the orcs.
